deep.reconstruction: The page is essentially blank. The only marks are the archival page number '166' written by hand at the bottom left, and very faint typed text showing through the paper. That faint text matches the following page (167) line for line: a centred heading 'Unités', then 'Soit K un corps de nombres algébriques plongé dans C. Les conditions suivantes sont alors équivalentes : a) pour toute unité ε de K, il y a n ∈ N, n>0 tel que ε^n soit réel ; b) ou bien K ⊂ R ou bien K se met sous la forme K_0(α) ...', ending with the 'Exemple' paragraph on K = Q(ζ). The underlined words, the marginal correction at upper right ('de degré p≥2') and the closing 3-line paragraph fall in the same places as on page 167. So the page has no mathematical content of its own; it is the blank back or interleaf of the next typescript sheet. For context only: page 167 proves a standard fact. Every unit of a number field K ⊂ C has a power that is real exactly when K is real or K is a CM field (a totally imaginary quadratic extension of a totally real field). The proof compares unit ranks via Dirichlet's unit theorem. The previous page is unrelated: it belongs to a Bourbaki-style draft on point distributions and convolution on manifolds (Variétés différentielles et analytiques style). The folder evidently mixes heterogeneous typescripts.
